preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100.
Each integer n must be a positive integer between 1 and 10^12.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if n not in powerful_numbers else str(k)
postconditions.description: If n cannot be represented as the sum of distinct powerful numbers, output -1; otherwise, output the minimum k.
The minimum number k must be a positive integer.
